evidence.name: Screen field: Gradient overlay color
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Gradient overlay color" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Gradient overlay color
sections.description: Sets the color of the dark fade laid over your media (default black). Black works best behind white text; choose a dark brand color if you want the fade to feel on-theme. The overlay always fades to clear at the top, so only this base color matters. It appears only when the gradient overlay is turned on.
